title: On a 360 px phone the person's face at the foot of the rail stays pressable beside a fullscreen right panel, and a submenu that fits neither side opens off its own row
steps: S1: Run the two e2e cases of packages/ui/tracy-sidebar/test/e2e/rail-beside-fullscreen-panel.test.mjs (a page laid out like dsh's frame with Tracy's real stylesheet).
S2: Run the popover keyboard case for a phone width in packages/core/tracy-core/test/popover-keyboard.test.mjs.
expect: S1: at 360x740 elementFromPoint at the face's centre is the face and the panel starts at x 56; at 1280 a fullscreen panel still starts at x 0.
S2: the side panel lies above or below its row, never over it, and stays on screen.
evidence: Stand acm 09/10/2026: at 360x740 the Browser panel covered the rail (iframe at the face's centre); tasks/evidence/account-menu/stand/mobile-fix-*.png.
fence: Tracy CSS max-width on the fullscreen panel below 768 px and PopoverSubmenu placement. Not covered: a rail expanded to 280 px on a phone.

tests: at 360×740 the face at the rail foot can be pressed beside a fullscreen right panel
on a wide window a fullscreen panel the person chose still covers the whole frame
on a phone width where neither side fits, the side panel opens below its row, not over it
